# Convertio

> Free browser-based tools for converting and organizing image, PDF, audio, and video files. Files are processed locally in the visitor's browser; no conversion backend receives the selected files.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://convertio.si/): Free online file converter and overview of browser-based tools.
- [All working tools](https://convertio.si/tools/): Directory of available converters and utilities.
- [About](https://convertio.si/about/): How the tools work and their limitations.
- [Privacy](https://convertio.si/privacy/): File handling, temporary browser storage, and hosting-provider data.
- [Terms](https://convertio.si/terms/): Usage and compatibility limitations.

## Working tools
### Images
- [JPG to PNG](https://convertio.si/jpg-to-png/)
- [PNG to JPG](https://convertio.si/png-to-jpg/)
- [WebP to JPG](https://convertio.si/webp-to-jpg/)
- [WebP to PNG](https://convertio.si/webp-to-png/)
- [JPG to WebP](https://convertio.si/jpg-to-webp/)
- [PNG to WebP](https://convertio.si/png-to-webp/)
- [Image Compressor](https://convertio.si/image-compressor/)
- [Image Resizer](https://convertio.si/image-resizer/)
- [Crop Image](https://convertio.si/crop-image/)
- [Rotate Image](https://convertio.si/rotate-image/)

### PDF
- [JPG to PDF](https://convertio.si/jpg-to-pdf/)
- [PNG to PDF](https://convertio.si/png-to-pdf/)
- [PDF to JPG](https://convertio.si/pdf-to-jpg/)
- [Merge PDF](https://convertio.si/merge-pdf/)
- [Split PDF](https://convertio.si/split-pdf/)
- [Rotate PDF](https://convertio.si/rotate-pdf/)
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://convertio.si/delete-pdf-pages/)

### Audio and video
- [MP4 to MP3](https://convertio.si/mp4-to-mp3/)
- [MOV to MP4](https://convertio.si/mov-to-mp4/)
- [WAV to MP3](https://convertio.si/wav-to-mp3/)
- [Video Compressor](https://convertio.si/video-compressor/)
- [Audio Compressor](https://convertio.si/audio-compressor/)
- [Video to GIF](https://convertio.si/video-to-gif/)

## Important limitations
- Processing is local to the browser; browser memory, supported codecs, and device performance affect results.
- The media file picker has a 200 MB limit. Files near the limit may still fail on low-memory devices.
- The coming-soon list describes unavailable features and should not be treated as working tools.
